question: In 1987, the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) succeeded in forging an agreement to freeze CFC production at ______ levels.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1986**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nairobi is the headquarter of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). 

 
 
• The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is responsible for coordinating responses to environmental issues within the United Nations system.
 
• It was established by Maurice Strong, its first director, after the United Nations Conference on the Human Environment in Stockholm in June 1972.
 
• Its mandate is to provide leadership, deliver science and develop solutions on a wide range of issues, including climate change, the management of marine and terrestrial ecosystems, and green economic development.
 
• As a member of the United Nations Development Group, UNEP aims to help the world meet the 17 Sustainable Development Goals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The UNEP's mission is to provide leadership and encourage partnership in caring for the environment by inspiring, informing, and enabling nations and peoples to improve their quality of life without compromising that of future generations.
 
• The UNEP is the coordinating body for the United Nations' environmental activities.
 
 
• It assesses environmental conditions and trends at the global, regional and national levels
 
• it develops international agreements and national environmental instruments
 
• It strengthens institutions for wise environmental management.
